headline: As of 2026-10-24: 26,714,411 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 26,714,411 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,824,720), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,597,579).
